'''Factor Jarvus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and presented a task to a fellow Imperial. He was sent to Nar Shaddaa by the Sith Empire to buy designs for experimental armor.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Bidding War|Nar Shadaa}}</ref>
